name: darling-runtime
description: Use the bundled Darling Linux compatibility runtime for macOS CLI binaries and compiler-oriented workflows.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only package for Darling on Ubuntu 24.04 amd64. It includes selected Darling binary packages, installation guidance, license texts, provenance, hashes, and source-compliance instructions. Intended primarily for macOS command-line tools and compiler workflows on compatible Linux hosts.
defaultPrompt: Set up the bundled Darling runtime for a macOS CLI tool.
Help me run this Mach-O compiler with Darling.
Check which bundled Darling components this CLI program needs.
